description: Smart Time Filter is a multi-mode date slicer that replaces three separate filters with a single, compact visual. End users switch between three filtering modes directly from the report — no need for editors to pre-configure separate slicers. ▸ CALENDAR PERIODS Filter by Month, Quarter, or Year of a specific calendar period. Includes shortcuts for the current Month-to-Date, Quarter-to-Date, and Year-to-Date so dashboards always open on the most relevant range. ▸ ROLLING TIME Rolling windows of 1, 3, 6, or 12 months, ending at the end of the previous month, end of the current month, today, or yesterday. Ideal for trend visuals and KPI tiles that need a consistent look-back period regardless of when the report is opened. ▸ CUSTOM RANGE Two native date pickers for ad-hoc analysis when calendar periods and rolling windows are not enough. KEY BENEFITS • One slicer instead of three. Less clutter on the report canvas and fewer slicers for users to learn. • State is persisted. The user's last selection is saved with the report, so dashboards open in the same state every time. • Synchronizable. Works with Power BI's "Sync slicers" feature, so the selected period can drive multiple pages at once. • Standard filter API. The visual emits a standard Power BI filter through applyJsonFilter, so every other visual on the page reacts to it — no DAX or model changes required. • Fully styleable.…
